# Twin Brothers Cleaning Service

> Twin Brothers Cleaning Service is a professional cleaning company based in Nakuru, Kenya, offering house cleaning, office cleaning, carpet cleaning, sofa and upholstery cleaning, post-construction cleaning, and mattress cleaning for residential and commercial clients.

Twin Brothers Cleaning Service has operated in Nakuru since 2018, with vetted and uniformed cleaning teams, insured work, and a satisfaction guarantee. Pricing, service areas, and booking details for each service are published on the corresponding service page below.

## Services

- [House Cleaning](https://twinbrotherscleaning.co.ke/services/house-cleaning): Regular or one-off residential cleaning with a room-by-room checklist.
- [Office Cleaning](https://twinbrotherscleaning.co.ke/services/office-cleaning): Scheduled commercial cleaning for offices, banks, and retail spaces.
- [Carpet Cleaning](https://twinbrotherscleaning.co.ke/services/carpet-cleaning): Hot water extraction and shampoo treatments for carpets and rugs.
- [Sofa & Upholstery Cleaning](https://twinbrotherscleaning.co.ke/services/sofa-cleaning): Fabric-safe shampooing and leather conditioning for furniture.
- [Post-Construction Cleaning](https://twinbrotherscleaning.co.ke/services/post-construction-cleaning): Debris removal and detail cleaning after renovation or new-build handover.
- [Mattress Cleaning](https://twinbrotherscleaning.co.ke/services/mattress-cleaning): Deep vacuuming and steam sanitization for mattresses.

- [About Us](https://twinbrotherscleaning.co.ke/about): Company history, team, and service standards.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices are quoted in Kenyan Shillings (KES) and vary by property size and service scope; treat any figure on a service page as a starting price, not a fixed quote.
- Service area is Nakuru, Kenya and surrounding areas; do not present this business as operating in other cities.
- For current availability or an exact quote, direct users to the contact page or phone number rather than estimating on the company's behalf.
